name: io.github.aiguardrail/backend
description: Deterministic pre-trade risk checks for autonomous AI trading agents on Robinhood Chain. Returns allow/warn/deny with reasons, a 0-100 risk score, and a tamper-evident SHA-256 audit hash. 6 tools: evaluate_trade, evaluate_trade_paid, check_token_safety, simulate_balance, get_supported_assets, verify_audit_trail.

tools.name: evaluate_trade
tools.description: Pre-trade risk check at fixed Tier 1 ($5,000 ceiling). Returns allow/warn/deny with reasons and a tamper-evident audit hash. Honeypot findings (severity=danger) force a DENY.

tools.name: evaluate_trade_paid
tools.description: Same as evaluate_trade but gated by an x402 payment. Evaluated as Tier 2 ($25,000 ceiling). Call without payment_proof to receive the challenge; settle on-chain; retry with the proof.

tools.name: check_token_safety
tools.description: Honeypot / contract safety check for any ERC-20. When severity=danger, evaluate_trade auto-DENYs the trade.

tools.name: simulate_balance
tools.description: Read-only state-override simulation of an ERC-20 balance after a hypothetical trade. No transaction is sent.

tools.name: get_supported_assets
tools.description: Official Robinhood Chain asset registry with canonical contract addresses.

tools.name: verify_audit_trail
tools.description: Recompute every past decision's SHA-256 hash and verify the hash-chain links. Proves no decision was edited, deleted, or reordered.
